entities.name: Endless Sea
entities.description: Body of water north of the Terisian Isles, bordering Gulmany and the Balduvian Steppes.

entities.name: Terisian Isles
entities.description: Islands formed from the former Terisiare.

entities.name: Gulmany
entities.description: Land whose northern shores the Endless Sea borders.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War during which the sea ran from the Colekgan Mountains.

entities.name: Dark Age
entities.description: Era when the Endless Sea formed icebergs.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Era when ice floes coalesced into ice caps.

events.summary: During the Ice Age, the ice floes coalesced into massive ice caps with glacial spurs running onto the continent.
events.quote: During the Ice Age , the ice floes coalesced into massive ice caps

relations.quote: The Endless Sea is the part of the Dominarian ocean that lies north of the Terisian Isles
